purpose: Rerun of stage k10 of study_k_v1 (Example 1, Setting 1, NUTS, k = 10) with nothing else running on the machine (user decision, 28 Oct 2026). During the first k10 batch of study_k_v1 the 1/5/15-min load average rose from 3.1/4.0/4.9 to 7.1/27.7/31.3, other processes rebuilt a paper PDF and regenerated figures, and the worker time per PDE solve was 12.28 ms against 11.11-11.47 ms for k = 14, 20, 28. Settings, seeds and prior-draw starts are those of study_k_v1; study_k_v1 and its outputs are kept unchanged. Declared and frozen before the run; a change of any setting requires a new manifest id and output tag.

prior.k_note: k = 14 is the production value checked against config.py; stages override k

model.plateau_bounds_note: joint-setting bounds of config.py, checked by the driver but not used by the v1 stages

data.note: existing observation files; their bytes are tracked in git and must not be regenerated

nuts.target_rationale: target 0.95, the primary Example 1 configuration (production_v1_t095) and the setting of the earlier k-study runs

diagnostics.monitored: all KL coefficients and the junction depth at x = 0.5; c_p and c_n in the joint setting
diagnostics.undefined: an undefined R-hat or ESS of any monitored quantity means not passed
diagnostics.checkpoints: retrospective, on prefixes of the capped runs; costs from per-draw records; first pass reported with persistence, or 'not reached within the cap'

divergences.follow_up_rule: more than 0.5 % of the retained draws, or at least 3 divergences with 75 % or more in one chain
divergences.handling: report count, chain and location; keep the output; investigate the states; never change settings silently

timing.batches: one four-chain sampler batch at a time, no other heavy jobs on the machine
reported: aggregate worker time (sum over chains), sampling only and including warm-up
actual batch elapsed time from launch to the last chain end (epoch timestamps)
timing.excluded_from_sampler_timers: model construction and KL set-up (included in the batch elapsed time)

failure_handling: outputs are validated with check_run.py --production; an invalid output stops the driver and is kept for inspection; a valid run that fails the diagnostics or needs divergence follow-up is kept and flagged, never silently rerun with other settings
scope: Example 1, known plateaus (Setting 1): NUTS at k = 10 (stage k10), N_KL = 12.

predeclared.reporting: the k = 10 row of the sensitivity table (ESS per wall-clock second) uses this run; the first k10 batch of study_k_v1 stays in study.json, reported with its load record
predeclared.reproduction_check: compared draw by draw with results/nuts_Setting1_Ex1_kstudy_k10 and results/nuts_Setting1_Ex1_study_k_v1_k10; any difference is reported with its likely cause
